title: DoS in `cancelNextBid()` due to insufficient `topBid` deposit
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The current implementation only checks if `(topBid.deposit / topBid.rent) < K(id)`, and if this condition is true, it reverts with `AmAmm__BidLocked`. This validation can be exploited by a malicious `topBid` bidder to prevent the `nextBid` bidder from canceling their bid.  ```solidity File: AmAmm.sol 292:     function cancelNextBid(PoolId id, address recipient) external virtual override returns (uint256 refund) { 293:         /// ----------------------------------------------------------------------- 294:         /// Vali
